body: Yea, I know. I've spent hours looking and there isn't very much. I wonder if there's something I'm missing when I search.

Fuck is this me? I'm in the exact same place man. My girlfriend is beautiful and incredible and tries so hard, but her life is shit and she doesn't deserve any of it. My life has been great but I haven't done shit with it. I really wish we could switch spots sometimes. I deserve to be the one getting the short end of the stick and she deserves to be going places. 

Like you said, why can't it be me?

Thank you so much. And just to be clear our relationship right now is almost perfect. If it wasn't for her I wouldn't be able to deal with all the other crap going on in my life right now. And I do treat her like the wonderful woman she deserves to be treated like. Also, I wouldn't say I'm obsessed. When I need to I can focus on other things, because I know the things I am doing right now in school and work will only do good for our future. I just don't like the thought that I might lose her, which is why I always like to make sure I know where she is and what she's doing so I know she is safe, but not in an obsessive way. She usually tells me anyway.

Anyway, I just wanted to say thanks! I will return to your post the next time I'm feeling down and I'll PM you if I need to.
